title: Quick Tip: GitHub Copilot Chat Modes Are Now Agents, and Edit Mode Is Gone
summary: GitHub Copilot Chat modes have been reorganized into agent roles in VS Code. The Edit mode has been replaced by diff-based editing within Agent, Plan is now a built-in role, and custom chat modes are now custom agents with a new file extension and configuration interface.
key_points: Chat modes are now called agent roles: Agent, Ask, and Plan are the built-in set
Edit mode was discontinued; its diff-based editing capabilities moved into Agent
Plan is now a proper built-in role that creates implementation plans and hands off to Agent for coding
Custom chat modes became custom agents with .agent.md file extension instead of .chatmode.md
VS Code split the dropdown into Session Target (harness selection) and Agent picker (role selection)

quotes.text: Edit did not survive, its diff based editing now sits inside Agent.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical change for users relying on Edit mode; they need to know the functionality moved into Agent
